title: lichen-core: clippy manual_range_contains error blocks cargo clippy --workspace gates
description: cargo clippy -p lichen-rpl --all-targets -- -D warnings fails in dependency lichen-core at src/tdma_beacon.rs:185: 'let len = if first >= 0x80 && first <= 0x97' -> clippy::manual_range_contains suggests (0x80..=0x97).contains(&first). Pre-existing at HEAD, outside lichen-rpl scope so not fixed by worker6-26l6; it forces every dependent-crate clippy gate to run with --no-deps until fixed.
